name: Another Day
source:
Sebastian is at the end of his rope. Tired of the pain, he goes to end his life but stumbles upon someone who is planning to do the same.

Another Day is a game that focuses on mental health and talks about the experience of coming out and being transgender.

[From [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/another-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞巴斯蒂安已是山穷水尽。厌倦了痛苦，他打算结束自己的生命，却偶然发现有人也计划这样做。

Another Day是一款专注于心理健康并谈论出柜和变性经历的游戏。

[来自[url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/another-day]Itch.io[/url]]
